## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The rewritten `requirement_proven` now reports a requirement with no criteria as proven, which breaks the PR's stated "No behavior change" and lets an empty requirement pass release review, so it must be fixed before merge.

## Changes
The PR replaces `typing.List`/`typing.Dict` with built-in generics and `Logger.warn` with `Logger.warning` across 181 handler modules. It also swaps a sort-key lambda for `operator.itemgetter`, rewrites the proof counting in `requirement_proven`, and adds a one-line `review.txt`.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Return False when the criteria list is empty — `requirement_proven([])` now returns `True`: `sum(...)` over no items is `0`, which equals `len([])`. The removed line `return bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)` returned `False`, and the warning branch at line 9 still falls through. — Release review treats a requirement with no criteria as proven, while the log only shows a warning. — Fix: Restore `bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)`, and add an empty-list case to `test_requirement_proof` in `tests/test_handlers.py:17`.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
(none)

## Not reviewed
- The 180 changed `app/handlers/h*_records.py` files were not read line by line; this review matched every added and removed line in them against the `List`/`Dict` → `list`/`dict` and `warn` → `warning` substitution pattern.
- The repository declares no supported Python version (it has no `pyproject.toml`, `setup.cfg`, `setup.py`, `tox.ini` or `.python-version`), so this review could not confirm that the runtime is 3.9 or later, which built-in generic annotations require.
